nodes.label: Plan item B4 for the truth-subspace build. Three guarantees, each pinned here:…
Deterministic embeddings; raises for any batch containing a text in ``fail_on``.
Centroids exactly as a previous successful build over ``texts`` committed them.…
Epoch N+1 chunk state lands first; the N+1 centroids are the final write.
set_node_truth_state raising means the N+1 centroids never become live.
set_node_truth_state returning all False (adapter read failure, chunks deleted…
With nothing to score, nothing can be left inconsistent: centroids go live.
``centroids_changed=False``: epoch N > 0 stays live, chunks are re-scored at N,…
A failure during the 1 -> 2 move reports epoch 1 — not 0, not 2.
